analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.09) vs SMA5 ($0.09)/SMA20 ($0.07)/SMA50 ($0.07) — short-term trend pause, above mid-term trend
· Position relative to SMA100 ($0.08)/SMA200 ($0.09) — above long-term trend, acting as strong support
· 52-week position (10.5%) + current price level recovered from 52-week low ($0.07)
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (81.4→84.4) — continued overbought, upward momentum sustained
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0028→0.0028) — bullish momentum holding, no trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $0.09) — approaching upper resistance, band width expanded to 43.29%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($0.09) — aligns with current price, strong short-term support
· Swing Resistance ($0.10) — aligns with 5-day high, short-term resistance zone
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower High) — short-term high is lower, suggesting potential for bearish reversal
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) — observation phase due to short-term overheating and volume contraction, potential for further upside if $0.10 resistance is broken
analysis.patternNote: 5일 고가 $0.10, 20일 고가 $0.10으로 고점 유지 실패, Lower High 패턴 형성. 단기 고점 낮아짐.
